chunks: What was narrated by Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Yūnus, from Ṣabbāḥ ibn Ṣabīḥ, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
A man intended to perform the Friday prayer, then he recited
He عليه السلام said: He completes it as two rakʿahs, then begins again. And that which indicates what we have said...

key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ, recited here in the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he recites Qul Huwa Allahu Aḥad during the Friday prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal ruling concerning recitation in the Friday prayer. It indicates that if a person recites Sūrat al-Tawḥīd in a context requiring a different recitational order, he should complete two rakʿahs and then restart, showing the juristic importance of prescribed recitation in Jumuʿah.
